scenarios.name: printed-characteristics
scenarios.why: Oracle gives Craterhoof Behemoth printed power/toughness 5/5 and Haste. On entering the battlefield its own enters trigger also fires: 'creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control'. With only itself on the battlefield X=1, so it is a 6/6 with trample and haste after the trigger resolves (CR 208.3, 603.6a, 702.10, 702.2).
